findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Observed the bathroom to the right of the water fountain did not have paper towels. The PIC provided paper towels to the bathroom during the inspection. Ensure there is always paper towels available at every hand washing sink.
findings.citation_text: 6-301.12 Hand Drying Provision. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; or (C) A heated-air hand drying device; or (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed in the back receiving room to the right of the exit door there was a large crack in the wall. The PIC filled the crack with caulk during the inspection. Ensure the crack remains sealed to be a smooth, easily cleanable surface and prevent the entry of pests.
findings.citation_text: 6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment: Observed several roaches at the facility. There were two glue traps with many dead roaches on them. There were also large dead roaches observed throughout the back of the facility and a couple in the main store. Additionally, one alive roach was seen on the water fountain and one in the back storage. There was also a large amount of drain flies throughout the entire facility. Upon entering the store and being asked about roaches the PIC stated that they are aware and EcoLab had performed pest control recently. The PIC was instructed to contact EcoLab and get immediate service. They should also put down more glue traps to figure out the location of the roaches, eliminate entrance points, and remove cardboard quickly. There will be a follow-up in two weeks to ensure EcoLab has been to the facility and pests are being eliminated.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices
findings.comment:
Both bathrooms remain closed to the public. This is a repeat violation from the routine inspection performed on 12/14/2023. A follow-up is issued for 1/4/2024. See general comments for additional details. 

5-205.15: A PLUMBING SYSTEM shall be: (A) Repaired according to LAW; P and (B) Maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
Several coolers throughout the facility are observed to be out-of-order during the inspection. Out-of-order tags have been placed on all coolers which are not functioning properly. Per operator, the cause of the malfunctions is an electrical issue for which a ticket has been submitted. Ensure that equipment is maintained in good repair and functioning properly.

4-501.11: (A) EQUIPMENT shall be maintained in good repair. (B) EQUIPMENT components shall be kept intact, tight, and adjusted to manufacturer’s specifications. (C) Cutting or piercing parts of can opens shall be kept sharp to minimize metal fragmentation.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices
findings.comment:
Plumbing systems are required to be repaired according to LAW which includes but is not limited to the Illinois Plumbing Code (77 Ill. Adm. Code 890), Illinois Plumbing license Law (225 ILCS 320) and Illinois Building Code. Both bathrooms in the facility are closed to the public due to ongoing plumbing issues. One of the two bathrooms was closed during the previous routine inspection in December 2022. Repairs must be made to the bathrooms immediately and additional referrals will be made to ensure that plumbing meets all State and Local requirements. All repairs must be completed by a licensed plumber. Inspector will return on 12/20/2023 to check plumbing compliance as it relates to the 2017 FDA Food Code as adopted. 

5-205.15: A PLUMBING SYSTEM shall be: (A) Repaired according to LAW; P and (B) Maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Sewage and waste water properly disposed
findings.comment:
Soiled/odorous mop water is observed to be remaining in mop buckets near the utility sink after cleaning has concluded. All waste water must immediately be conveyed to the sanitary sewer. Mop buckets must be dumped immediately after completion of cleaning activities. Ensure that mop buckets are emptied as required. A follow-up is scheduled for 12/20/2023 to ensure mop buckets remain emptied. 

5-402.13: SEWAGE shall be conveyed to the point of disposal through an APPROVED sanitary SEWAGE system or other system, including use of SEWAGE transport vehicles, waste retention tanks, pumps, pipes, hoses, and connections that are constructed, maintained, and operated according to LAW.

findings.title: Toilet facilities: properly constructed, supplied, & cleaned
findings.comment:
During the inspection today, both toilets in the facility are closed to public and staff. At least one toilet must be provided and accessible; additional available bathrooms may be required per Illinois Plumbing Code (77 Ill. Adm. Code 890) and Illinois Building Code. Ensure that at least one toilet is available AT ALL TIMES.

5-203.12: At least 1 toilet and not fewer than the toilets required by LAW shall be provided. If authorized by LAW and urinals are substituted for toilets, the substitution shall be done as specified in LAW.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
The following aspects of the physical facility are in disrepair:
- The electrical system which has resulted in equipment failures
- The plumbing system which has resulted in closure of required toilet facilities
- The HVAC system resulting from exterior damage to pipes/equipment

These systems are incapable of functioning to serve their intended purpose due to being in a state of disrepair. Operator states that these issues have been ongoing and maintenance tickets have been submitted but no resolution has been provided. 

6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Wholesome, sound condition
findings.comment:
Observed several (4+) dented cans in the canned food aisle. Canned goods were removed from aisle to be returned to distributor. Cans with dents on the horizontal or vertical seams are considered to not be in sound condition. Cans with dents on the vertical or horizontal seams should not be put out on the sales floor. Cans should be inspected during stocking to ensure that dented cans are removed.
750-100 Food shall be in sound condition, free from spoilage, filth, and other contamination and shall be safe for human consumption.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment: (1) Observed the gasket on "Fresh Foods" reach in cooler to be falling into disrepair. Repair or replace gasket to provide a smooth, cleanable surface. (2) Observed the sliding door ice cream freezer to have an accumulation of ice/frost build up. Defrost and maintain freezer to provide a smooth, cleanable surface.750-600 Non-food contact surfaces shall be smooth and easily cleanable750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed a gap in the women's handwashing sink in the restroom. Seal the gap.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.
